workflows.title: Customer Onboarding
workflows.description: Validates and configures a new customer account through parallel verification and setup tasks.

jobs.title: Receive Application
jobs.description: Receive and register the customer's onboarding application.

jobs.title: Validate Customer Details
jobs.description: Validate the customer's submitted personal or business information.

jobs.title: Verify Identity
jobs.description: Verify the customer's identity using the provided documentation.

jobs.title: Perform Risk Check
jobs.description: Perform required risk and eligibility checks.

jobs.title: Create Customer Profile
jobs.description: Create the customer's profile after their details are validated.

jobs.title: Approve Customer
jobs.description: Approve the customer after identity and risk checks are complete.

jobs.title: Configure Account
jobs.description: Configure the customer's account after approval and profile creation.

jobs.title: Create Welcome Resources
jobs.description: Prepare welcome materials and onboarding resources for the customer.

jobs.title: Send Welcome Email
jobs.description: Send a welcome email after the account is configured and resources are ready.

jobs.title: Complete Onboarding
jobs.description: Mark the customer's onboarding process as complete.

workflows.title: Software Release Pipeline
workflows.description: Builds, tests, scans, and deploys a new release to production through parallel verification and staged rollout.

jobs.title: Receive Commit
jobs.description: Receive a new commit/merge event from version control.

jobs.title: Checkout Code
jobs.description: Check out the repository at the triggering commit.

jobs.title: Install Dependencies
jobs.description: Install all backend and frontend dependencies.

jobs.title: Lint Code
jobs.description: Run static linting rules across the codebase.

jobs.title: Run Unit Tests
jobs.description: Execute the unit test suite.

jobs.title: Run Static Analysis
jobs.description: Run type-checking and static code analysis tools.

jobs.title: Check Dependency Vulnerabilities
jobs.description: Scan installed dependencies for known security vulnerabilities.

jobs.title: Build Backend Artifact
jobs.description: Compile and package the backend service.

jobs.title: Build Frontend Artifact
jobs.description: Bundle and package the frontend application.

jobs.title: Run Integration Tests
jobs.description: Run integration tests against the built backend and frontend artifacts.

jobs.title: Run Security Scan
jobs.description: Run a security/static application security testing (SAST) scan on the built artifacts.

jobs.title: Generate API Docs
jobs.description: Auto-generate API documentation from the backend artifact.

jobs.title: Containerize Backend
jobs.description: Build a container image for the backend service.

jobs.title: Containerize Frontend
jobs.description: Build a container image for the frontend application.

jobs.title: Push Backend Image
jobs.description: Push the backend container image to the image registry.

jobs.title: Push Frontend Image
jobs.description: Push the frontend container image to the image registry.

jobs.title: Deploy Backend to Staging
jobs.description: Deploy the backend image to the staging environment.

jobs.title: Deploy Frontend to Staging
jobs.description: Deploy the frontend image to the staging environment.

jobs.title: Run End-to-End Tests
jobs.description: Run end-to-end tests against the staging environment.

jobs.title: Run Performance Tests
jobs.description: Run load and performance tests against the staging environment.

jobs.title: Manual QA Signoff
jobs.description: Gather final QA approval before production release, incorporating test, performance, docs, and vulnerability results.

jobs.title: Deploy Backend to Production
jobs.description: Deploy the approved backend image to production.

jobs.title: Deploy Frontend to Production
jobs.description: Deploy the approved frontend image to production.

jobs.title: Run Production Smoke Tests
jobs.description: Run smoke tests against the live production deployment.

jobs.title: Notify Release Complete
jobs.description: Notify the team that the release has been successfully deployed.
